idea: Seam construction with tilted squares: put a k-column grid on the left part of the square and a (k+1)-column grid on the right, with different row pitches. Along the vertical seam where the pitches mismatch, insert a column of slightly rotated squares. Optimise the seam position, the angles and the sides with SLSQP using exact separating-axis constraints, so that counts between the two lattices fill naturally.
